Subject: Post-call: ClearBank pricing tradeoffs — EU data-sovereignty cost delta & next steps

Tom / Elena — thanks again for a thoughtful 45m discussion this morning. Quick recap and the two asks we discussed: a) unit economics at two volume points so you can model against existing TCO, and b) clarity on the impact of EU-only data residency on per-token price. Below are what we heard and the initial numbers from our pricing scenarios (attached).

Call highlights (as we captured):
- Workload: customer-facing fraud scoring + chat summaries; estimated 4M–12M tokens/month for P1 (peak bursts) with strong diurnal spikes.
- Residency requirement: All customer data + logs must stay in eu-central region (no cross-border replication).
- SLA/uptime: 99.9% target; willingness to consider Dedicated or Private for a multi-region DR plan.

High-level unit-econ snapshots (hosted, per 1M tokens):
- Hosted (US region): $1,150 / 1M tokens (baseline)
- Hosted (EU region / eu-central): $1,420 / 1M tokens (~23.5% delta) — driven by reserved EU capacity premiums and network egress controls
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool, EU): ~$950 / 1M tokens at 50M+ commit (lower unit but requires spend commitment and 6–8 week provisioning)

Notes on variance: quantization and prefix caching can drive 20–40% effective cost down for repeated prompt patterns; Private (on-prem or VPC with KMS) adds fixed infra+ops that shift economics but removes cross-border and compliance concerns.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I attached a short pricing scenarios deck and a MAP with three commitment tiers (trial, mid-commit, enterprise). Please confirm which volume profile (4M / 8M / 12M) we should model against.
2) Schedule a 30m SE deep-dive to validate caching/latency assumptions (copying Monica to coordinate).
3) If procurement wants an initial pricing appendix for internal review, we can produce a 1-page EU-only quote + procurement checklist.

Attaching: Redwood_Pricing_Scenarios_Q2.pdf, MAP_ClearBank_20270428.xlsx

Best,
Aditya Rao
Business Lead, EMEA Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Aditya — useful summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we loop procurement: 

1) Residency: EU-only is mandatory for P1; is the EU hosted rate you quoted strictly eu-central only (no cross-region backups), or does that assume passive cross-region replication for DR? If the latter, can you provide a strict eu-only variant?

2) Unit-econ sensitivity: can you provide line items for 1M / 5M / 10M tokens (hosted EU-only) so our finance team can run sensitivity? We are trying to hit <$1,300 per 1M tokens as a target benchmark for operational costs.

3) Procurement timeline: likely 6–9 weeks but may need an internal security review first. Please include SOC2 and data processing addendum references in the MAP.

If you can share the 1-pg EU-only quote and the 1/5/10M unit-econ table, we’ll prioritize a SE call next week.
